judge.justification: The narrative is coherent and well-structured, but lacks depth and context in its reporting of protests and social unrest in Chile. The inclusion of a separate section on an unrelated topic (the launch of a campaign by the ONG Los Ojos De Chile) disrupts the flow of the narrative.
